lines.trans: Good morning! Excuse me, is the door locked?
Good morning. Not locked; lift the handle up first, then push.
Oh, it opened! Thank you. I am Qing, the new receptionist.
I'm called Chen. You arrived ten minutes early.
On my first day at work, I walk fast. Where is the computer?
In the drawer. Here we use this big paper ledger and a pencil.
A paper notebook? Really?
Paper still works when the power goes out.
Fair enough! Are these the keys?
Yes, eight rooms, eight brass keys. Room four's guest arrives today.
Great. Please tell me what I need to know.

lines.trans: Rule number one: drink hot tea first, then go answer the door.
